offers.conditions: £150 upfront for switching 3+ Direct Debits and paying in £2,000+/month salary within 30 days; a further 5×£30 for maintaining that pay-in and 10+ debit card payments over the next 5 months. No previous Barclays switch bonus; no currently open Barclays account on or before 1 Oct.

£450 upfront for switching 3+ Direct Debits and paying in £5,000+/month salary within 30 days; a further 5×£30 over the next 5 months. Needs £75,000+/year earnings (or large savings with Barclays). No previous Barclays switch bonus; no open Barclays account on or before 1 Oct.

£220 for a full switch with 2+ Direct Debits, depositing £2,000+ and spending £500+ on the debit card, all within 60 days. Not already an HSBC/First Direct customer, and no HSBC/First Direct current account held since 1 Jan 2023.

£500 for earning £100,000+/year (paid into the account) and switching in within 90 days, OR having £100,000+ saved/invested with no switch needed. No HSBC/First Direct current account held since 1 Jan 2025.

£210 for switching in an account with 2+ Direct Debits/standing orders, paying in £1,000+, and 5+ debit card payments, all within 45 days. Never had ANY First Direct product; also excluded if an HSBC current account has been opened since 1 Jan 2018 (a cross-bank condition this engine doesn't check — verify by hand).

£200 for switching in an account from a different bank (not Halifax/Bank of Scotland) with 3+ Direct Debits; the switch must START by 9 Dec. No previous switch bonus from Lloyds, Halifax or Bank of Scotland since 1 Jan 2023.

£200 for switching in from a different bank (not Halifax/Bank of Scotland) with 3+ Direct Debits, switch must start by 9 Dec. Needs £5,000+/month pay-in (roughly an £85,000 salary) or £100,000+ saved/invested. No previous switch bonus from Lloyds, Halifax or Bank of Scotland since 1 Jan 2023.

£200 for switching in and paying in £1,250+ within 60 days, plus logging into the mobile app. No previous NatWest/RBS/Ulster Bank switch bonus; no NatWest account on 6 May; not switching from an RBS or Ulster Bank account.

£500 for earning £100,000+/year (or £100,000+ saved/invested, or a £500,000+ NatWest mortgage) and paying in £15,000 within 90 days of the switch completing. No previous NatWest/RBS/Ulster Bank switch bonus; no NatWest account on or after 2 Sep.

£175 for switching in an account with 2+ Direct Debits within 28 days of opening, then paying in £1,000+ and making at least one debit card payment within 31 days of opening. No Nationwide switch bonus since 2021 (a sole↔joint switch is an exception); not switching from a Virgin Money account.
